## Merge reads

### example
```
usearch -fastq_mergepairs SampleA_R1.fastq -reverse SampleA_R2.fastq -fastqout merged.fq
```

### directory for merged files

```{r}
dir_fastq.merge <- paste0(dir_int,"/fastq_merge")
dir.create(
  dir_fastq.merge
  )
```

### usearch

```{r}
usearch <- paste0(dir_home,"documentation/software/usearch/usearch11.0.667_i86linux32")
```

### loop merge for each reaction

```{r}
for (i in seq_along(rxn)){
system(
  # merge paired ends
  paste0(
  usearch," ",
  "-fastq_mergepairs ",
  in.fastq[grepl(rxn[i],in.fastq)][1]," ",
  "-reverse ",
  in.fastq[grepl(rxn[i],in.fastq)][2]," ",
  "-fastqout ",
  dir_fastq.merge,"/",rxn[i],".fq"
  ),
  intern = F)
  # append to single file
  system(
  # merge paired ends
  paste0(
  "cat ", 
  dir_fastq.merge,"/",rxn[i],".fq",
  " >> ", dir_fastq.merge,"/","all.merged.fq"
  ),
  intern = F)
}


```

### FastQC

Post-merge, average base quality consistently exceeds 30, fragments range from 50-581 bp, and there is a 8bp repetative sequence at the start of the fragments. 

### rarify reads

```{r}
# Directories / Functions
seqtk <- paste0(dir_home,"documentation/software/seqtk/seqtk")
# only works in no existing files are present
system(paste0(
  "rm ", dir_fastq.merge,"/*_r.fq"
  ),intern = TRUE)
# Parameters
seed = 4438  # set seed
n <- 450 # subset size
# Iterate for each file
for (i in seq_along(rxn)){
system(paste0(
  seqtk," sample ",
  "-s",seed," ",
  # find merged file
  list.files(dir_fastq.merge,
           pattern = rxn[i],
           all.files = TRUE,full.names = TRUE,recursive = TRUE)," ",
  n, " > ",
  # write over old file
  dir_fastq.merge,"/",rxn[i],"_r.fq"
), 
       intern = TRUE)
  }
```


## filter reads

### input merge files

```{r}
# list files
list.files(dir_fastq.merge,
           pattern = "_r.fq",
           all.files = TRUE,full.names = TRUE,recursive = TRUE
           ) -> in.fq
```

```{r}
dir_fastq.filter <- paste0(dir_int,"/fastq_filter")
dir.create(
  dir_fastq.filter
  )
```

### fastq_filter

```{r}
fastq_truncqual = 33 # Truncate the read at the first position having quality score <= N, so that all remaining Q scores are >N.
fastq_maxee = 0.5 # Discard reads with > E total expected errors for all bases in the read after any truncation options have been applied.
fastq_maxns = 0 # Discard if there are >k Ns in the read.
fastq_stripleft = 8 # Delete the first N bases in the read.
for (i in seq_along(in.fq)){
system(
  paste0(
  usearch," ",
  "-fastq_filter ",
  in.fq[i]," ",
  "-fastq_truncqual ",fastq_truncqual," ",
  "-fastq_maxee ",fastq_maxee," ",
  "-fastq_maxns ",fastq_maxns," ",
  "-fastq_stripleft ",fastq_stripleft," ",
  "-fastaout ",dir_fastq.filter,"/",rxn[i],".fasta"
  ),
  intern = F)
  }
```

### fastx_uniques

Find unique read sequences and abundances


```{r}
# list files
list.files(dir_fastq.filter,
           pattern = ".fasta",
           all.files = TRUE,full.names = TRUE,recursive = TRUE
           ) -> in.fasta
```


```{r}
for ( i in seq_along(in.fasta)){
  system(
    paste0(
      usearch," ",
      "-fastx_uniques ",
      in.fasta[i]," ",
      "-sizeout ",
      "-relabel ","Uniq ",
      "-fastaout ",dir_fastq.filter,"/",rxn[i],"_uniques.fa"
    ),
    intern = F)
}
```

## OTU analysis

```{r}
dir_analysis <- paste0(dir_int,"/analysis")
dir.create(
  dir_analysis
  )
```

### Make OTU table

```{r}
# list files
list.files(dir_fastq.filter,
           pattern = "_otus.fa",
           all.files = TRUE,full.names = TRUE,recursive = TRUE
           ) -> in.otu
```

```{r}
for ( i in seq_along(in.otu)){
  system(
    paste0(
      usearch," ",
      "-otutab ",
      in.fq[i]," ",
      "-otus ",
      in.otu[i]," ",
      "-otutabout ",
      dir_analysis,"/",rxn[i],"_otutab_raw.txt"
    ),
    intern = F)
}
```
```{r}
# list files
list.files(dir_analysis,
           pattern = "_otutab_raw.txt",
           all.files = TRUE,full.names = TRUE,recursive = TRUE
           ) -> in.otutab_raw
```

```{r}
otu.tab <- list() # list of otu tables
otu.n <- list() # number otus per reaction
n.rep <- list() # number or replicate rxns
for (i in seq_along(in.otutab_raw)){
  otu.tab[[i]]<- read.table(in.otutab_raw[i],sep = "\t")
  colnames(otu.tab[[i]]) <- c("otu","count")
  otu.n[[i]] <- nrow(otu.tab[[i]])
  n.rep[[i]] <- substr(rxn[[i]], nchar(rxn[[i]]), nchar(rxn[[i]]))
}
names(otu.tab)<-rxn

data.frame(rxn, 
           unlist(otu.n),
           unlist(n.rep),
           grepl("N",rxn)
           ) -> otu.df
colnames(otu.df) <- c("rxn","n.otu","n.rep","negative")

# visualize
library(ggpubr)
# otu replicate vs negative
ggboxplot(otu.df, x = "negative", y = "n.otu",
          add = "dotplot",xlab = "negative",ylab = "number OTUs") + 
  stat_compare_means() -> p1
# number of otu by replicate, negatives excluded
ggboxplot(otu.df[otu.df$negative==F,], x = "n.rep", y = "n.otu",
          add = "dotplot",xlab = "number replicates, swabs",ylab = "number OTUs") + 
  stat_compare_means() -> p2
# number of otu by replicate, negatives excluded
ggboxplot(otu.df[otu.df$negative==T,], x = "n.rep", y = "n.otu",
          add = "dotplot",xlab = "number replicates, negatives",ylab = "number OTUs") + 
  stat_compare_means() -> p3

ggarrange(p1,p2,p3, ncol = 3, nrow = 1) -> p
```




### Normalize reads / sample

```{r}
rps = 100 # reads per samples
for ( i in seq_along(in.otutab_raw)){
  system(
    paste0(
      usearch," ",
      "-otutab_norm ",
      in.otutab_raw[i]," ",
      "-sample_size ",rps," ",
      "-output ",
      dir_analysis,"/",rxn[i],"_otutab.txt"
    ),
    intern = F)
}

```

### Alpha diversity

```{r}
for ( i in seq_along(in.otutab_raw)){
  system(
    paste0(
      usearch," ",

      in.otutab_raw[i]," ",
      "-output ",

    ),

}
```

### Make OTU tree

```{r}
id <- 0.8 # identity threshold.
linkage <- "min" # max (the default), min or avg.
for ( i in seq_along(in.otutab_raw)){
  system(
    paste0(
      usearch," ",
      "-cluster_aggd ",
      in.otu[i]," ",
      "-treeout ",
      dir_analysis,"/",rxn[i],"_otu.tree"," ",
      "-clusterout ",
      dir_analysis,"/",rxn[i],"_clusters.txt"," ",
      "-id ",id," ",
      "-linkage ",linkage
 ),
    intern = F)
}
```

## Predict Taxonomy

### compare to database
$usearch -sintax otus.fa -db ../data/rdp_16s_v16.fa -strand both \
  -tabbedout sintax.txt -sintax_cutoff 0.8

### Taxonomy summary reports
$usearch -sintax_summary sintax.txt -otutabin otutab.txt -rank g -output genus_summary.txt
$usearch -sintax_summary sintax.txt -otutabin otutab.txt -rank p -output phylum_summary.txt

### Find OTUs that match mock sequences
$usearch -uparse_ref otus.fa -db ../data/mock_refseqs.fa -strand plus \
  -uparseout uparse_ref.txt -threads 1
